event_name: Date 07 May 2022 Time 17:35 2022 MIAMI GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 May 2022 The Stewards have received a request from BWT Alpine F1 Team to allow car 31 to start the race despite failing to set a qualifying time in Q1. In accordance with Article 42.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 31, Esteban Ocon, to start the race, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event. The car will be placed on the grid in accordance with Article 42.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Competitors are reminded that they have the right to appeal certain decisions of the Stewards, in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code and Chapter 4 of the FIA Judicial and Disciplinary Rules, within the applicable time limits.
rules_referenced: Article 42.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Decision Car 31 Permission To Start The Race
